prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” roofer for every Dallas roof replacement — the right company depends on your needs (residential vs commercial), roof material, budget, insurance involvement, and timing. I can help you find the best fit. To narrow it down quickly, answer a couple questions or let me search by ZIP code:

- Is this a residential or commercial roof?
- Are you filing an insurance claim?
- Any preferred roofing material (asphalt shingle, metal, tile)?
- What ZIP code or neighborhood are you in?

How to choose the best Dallas roofer (quick checklist)
- Licensing & local requirements: Texas has varying local registration/permit rules; confirm the company follows Dallas permitting and code requirements.
- Insurance: Ask for current general liability and workers’ comp certificates and verify them.
- Manufacturer certifications: Look for GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster, or similar — these matter for warranties.
- Written estimate & contract: Get at least 3 written bids that list materials, labor, cleanup, permit costs, timeline, and payment schedule.
- Warranties: Confirm both manufacturer (shingle) and workmanship warranty terms and get them in writing.
- References & photos: Ask for recent local references and photos of completed jobs in Dallas.
- Reviews & complaints: Check Google/Angi/Yelp and the BBB for patterns, not just star ratings.
- Payment terms: Avoid large up-front cash payments; typical is a smaller deposit and balance on completion.
- Lien waivers: Make sure the contract includes post-completion lien waivers from subcontractors/suppliers.
- Red flags: High-pressure sales, only accepting cash, no physical address, missing insurance, or very low bids vs market rate.

If you want, I can:
- Pull a short list (3–5) of highly rated Dallas roofers in your ZIP code and summarize their reviews, credentials, and warranties.
- Provide a sample checklist/email you can send to contractors when requesting bids.

Tell me your ZIP code and a couple of the choices above (residential vs commercial, insurance, material) and I’ll find options for you.
